menu:3142350:1.text: Where could those baby terrabirds go...
menu:3142350:1.source_cn: 那些幼崽会跑到哪里去呢……

say:1:1122538001:1.text: You're right on time! I got a job for you.
say:1:1122538001:1.source_cn: 来得正好，有件委托要交给你。
say:1:1122538001:1.male: You're right on time! I got a job for you.
say:1:1122538001:1.female: You're right on time! I got a job for you.

say:2:1122538002:1.text: There's a Mauler clan in the Crimson Highlands that lost some baby terrabirds. I need someone to go over and investigate.
say:2:1122538002:1.source_cn: 深红高原上的蛮血部落丢失了好几只陆行鸟幼崽，而且四处都...

say:3:1122538003:1.text: A case like that is not something an ordinary bounty hunter can do. If you hadn't shown up today, I would've had to make the trip myself. Ha! Lucky me!
say:3:1122538003:1.source_cn: 但调查线索这种事，一般的赏金猎人可干不来。你今天要是不...
say:3:1122538003:1.male: A case like that is not something an ordinary bounty hunter can do. If you hadn't shown up today, I would've had to make the trip myself. Ha! Lucky me!
say:3:1122538003:1.female: A case like that is not something an ordinary bounty hunter can do. If you hadn't shown up today, I would've had to make the trip myself. Ha! Lucky me!

say:4:1122538004:1.text: I mean, aside from myself, you're the best there is in this gods-forsaken sandpit. If you get into too much trouble, though, holler at me.
say:4:1122538004:1.source_cn: 以你的实力，不管什么都能解决吧，要是有解决不了的，再喊...
say:4:1122538004:1.male: I mean, aside from myself, you're the best there is in this gods-forsaken sandpit. If you get into too much trouble, though, holler at me.
say:4:1122538004:1.female: I mean, aside from myself, you're the best there is in this gods-forsaken sandpit. If you get into too much trouble, though, holler at me.

say:1:1122540001:1.text: Ah! You must be the one who came to help with our terrabird problem.
say:1:1122540001:1.source_cn: 啊！你一定是来协助我们寻找陆行鸟的人吧！
say:1:1122540001:1.male: Ah! You must be the one who came to help with our terrabird problem.
say:1:1122540001:1.female: Ah! You must be the one who came to help with our terrabird problem.

say:2:1122540002:1.text: We scoured the area, but couldn't find any signs of the baby terrbirds. No clues at all...
say:2:1122540002:1.source_cn: 我们把附近翻了个遍，也没找到那些幼崽的踪迹，真是一点头...

say:5:1122540004:1.text: The hunters at the oasis camp said they saw some Quicksand Claws last night carrying little moving sacks. They must've stolen the terrabirds!
say:5:1122540004:1.source_cn: 绿洲营地那边的猎人们说，流沙之爪昨天半夜来过深红高原，...

say:6:1122540005:1.text: What?! It's those toad-eating Claws again... I'm going to make them regret ever touching my cute little terrabirds!
say:6:1122540005:1.source_cn: 什、什么？！可恶的流沙之爪……我要去找他们算账，救出可...

say:8:1122540006:1.text: Come with me! It's time to end this!
say:8:1122540006:1.male: Come with me! It's time to end this!
say:8:1122540006:1.female: Come with me! It's time to end this!

say:1:1122541002:0.text: Don't worry. Leave it to the magister!
say:1:1122541002:0.source_cn: 别担心，交给主人来解决吧！
say:1:1122541002:0.male: Don't worry. Leave it to the magister!
say:1:1122541002:0.female: Don't worry. Leave it to the magister!

say:0:1122542001:0.text: I've actually never dealt with the Claws before... I-I'm a little scared...
say:0:1122542001:0.source_cn: 我从来没跟流沙之爪打过交道，我、我不敢过去……

say:1:1122542002:0.text: Please save our baby terrabirds... Our whole clan would be grateful!
say:1:1122542002:0.source_cn: 你能把我们丢失的小陆行鸟带出来吗？我们全族人都会感激你的！
say:1:1122542002:0.male: Please save our baby terrabirds... Our whole clan would be grateful!
say:1:1122542002:0.female: Please save our baby terrabirds... Our whole clan would be grateful!

say:1:1122543001:1.text: Great! Everyone's here! Not a bird missing!
say:1:1122543001:1.source_cn: 太好了，我的小陆行鸟们……一个也不少！

say:2:1122543002:1.text: Thank you for everything! I'll take them back to the clan right now and let everyone rest easy! You're... swell.
say:2:1122543002:1.source_cn: 谢谢你帮我找回了它们！我这就带它们回族里，让大家都安心一点！
say:2:1122543002:1.male: Thank you for everything! I'll take them back to the clan right now and let everyone rest easy! You're... swell.
say:2:1122543002:1.female: Thank you for everything! I'll take them back to the clan right now and let everyone rest easy! You're... swell.
